data.name: MediaStageDescription
data.value: A call scene: one large main item and up to six thumbnails, the main one switched by a click or from the keyboard. Every item keeps its element when the main one changes, so a video keeps playing. Wide, the thumbnails sit in a column beside the main item; narrow, in a row below it that scrolls sideways.

data.name: MediaStageCountDescription
data.value: From none (an empty stage) to seven (one main item and six thumbnails); with one there is no thumbnail strip.

data.name: MediaStagePreviewDescription
data.value: Click a thumbnail, or Tab to its "Show large" button and press Enter, to make it the main item. Resize the window to see the layout follow the width of the stage.

data.name: MediaTileDescription
data.value: A live video the application owns (a call, a screen share, a camera) with its name, status icons, host actions, a full-screen button and a drawing layer laid exactly over the picture. Two tiles on one stream exchange their strokes through the page, and the frame exports as a PNG with the strokes over it.

data.name: MediaTileSettingsDescription
data.value: What the tiles show and how the picture sits in them.

data.name: MediaTileStreamDescription
data.value: The tiles show the demo stream (an animated canvas) or, off, no stream: the initials on a disc, still with the name and the icons.

data.name: MediaTileCoverDescription
data.value: Fit: Cover fills the whole tile and cuts the picture off, Contain (the default) shows all of it with bands. The drawing layer follows the picture either way.

data.name: MediaTileMutedDescription
data.value: The video plays without sound (the default, so it starts alone and one’s own stream does not echo). A remote peer’s stream is set to false.

data.name: MediaTileFullscreenDescription
data.value: The button in the action bar that makes the tile full screen (ShowFullscreen); ToggleFullscreenAsync does the same from code.

data.name: MediaTileDrawingDescription
data.value: A canvas laid exactly over the picture the video shows, bands excluded in Contain; its strokes are 0 to 1 of the picture, the same on every tile size.

data.name: MediaTileDrawingToolbarDescription
data.value: Pen and eraser, colour, width, Undo and Clear in a bar above the video, never over the picture.

data.name: MediaTileDrawingReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The strokes stay visible but the pointer neither draws nor erases and reaches the tile (DrawingReadOnly); the toolbar is hidden.

data.name: MediaTileEraserDescription
data.value: The pointer erases whole strokes instead of drawing (DrawingTool); a stroke erased on one tile disappears from the other.

data.name: MediaTilePreviewDescription
data.value: Draw on either tile: the stroke appears on the other, which is square, and an erasure follows. Export as PNG shows the frame with the strokes over it.
